title: KYE Semantic Assertion
description: Binds a runtime decision to the ontology terms it relied on. Hash-chained into the audit ledger; included in the Continuity Evidence Pack™. Allows a third-party verifier to re-derive what the decision *meant* — not just what it returned.

subject_ref.description: URN of the runtime artefact this assertion describes — typically a decision_id or evidence_pack_id.

epistemic_status.description: HOW this assertion is known — the term key from kye:dictionary:epistemic-status (internal). assertion_type says what KIND of claim this is; epistemic_status says what STANDING it has. The dictionary carries verdict_admissible per term: `inferred` and `resolved` are NOT admissible as inputs to a sealed decision, because a verdict depending on them cannot be re-derived from published keys alone (§13 Replay-Proof™ / §0.47 air-gapped determinism). Note terms[].confidence is a per-term score, not a standing — a confident inference is still an inference.

epistemic_basis.description: How the epistemic_status was reached, per the dictionary's provenance_required for that term: the identified party (declared), the mechanism and version (inferred), the check id or named reviewer (verified), or the resolution policy ref (resolved).
